modules.title: Introduction to Revelation and the Qur'an
modules.html:
The first revelation to Prophet Muhammad, the compilation and preservation of the Qur'an, and its qualities as the word of Allah. This section covers introduction to revelation and the qur'an.

Key points

  • The Surah that is equivalent to one-third of the Qur'an in terms of reward and meaning is _____. — Surat al-Ikhlas.
  • The Surah that is equivalent to one-third of the Qur'an in terms of reward is _____. — Suratul-Ikhlas.
  • The first Surah of the Glorious Qur'an is known as _____. — Al-Fatihah.
  • The science of the rules governing the correct pronunciation of the Qur'an is called _____. — Tajwid.
  • The collection and compilation of the Qur'an into a single volume was initiated during the Caliphate of _____. — Abu Bakr.

Worked examples

Q: The Surah that is equivalent to one-third of the Qur'an in terms of reward and meaning is _____.
A: Surat al-Ikhlas — Surat al-Ikhlas summarizes the concept of Tawhid, which is the foundation of one-third of the Qur'anic message.

Q: The Surah that is equivalent to one-third of the Qur'an in terms of reward is _____.
A: Suratul-Ikhlas — Suratul-Ikhlas summarizes the concept of Tawhid, which represents one-third of the message of the Qur'an.

quiz.q: The Surah that is equivalent to one-third of the Qur'an in terms of reward and meaning is _____.
quiz.solution: Surat al-Ikhlas summarizes the concept of Tawhid, which is the foundation of one-third of the Qur'anic message.

quiz.q: The Surah that is equivalent to one-third of the Qur'an in terms of reward is _____.
quiz.solution: Suratul-Ikhlas summarizes the concept of Tawhid, which represents one-third of the message of the Qur'an.

quiz.q: The first Surah of the Glorious Qur'an is known as _____.
quiz.solution: Surat Al-Fatihah is the opening chapter of the Qur'an and is essential in every unit of the Muslim prayer (Salat).

quiz.q: The science of the rules governing the correct pronunciation of the Qur'an is called _____.
quiz.solution: Tajwid ensures that every letter of the Qur'an is pronounced correctly from its point of articulation with its proper characteristics.

quiz.q: The collection and compilation of the Qur'an into a single volume was initiated during the Caliphate of _____.
quiz.solution: Following the Battle of Yamamah where many huffaz died, Abu Bakr ordered Zaid b. Thabit to compile the Qur'an into a single book (Mushaf).

quiz.q: The number of Sajdah (prostration) marks found in the Qur'an is _____.
quiz.solution: Most scholars agree on 14 specific verses in the Qur'an where it is Sunnah to perform a prostration (Sajdah at-Tilawah) upon recitation.

quiz.q: The prophet mentioned most frequently by name in the Qur'an is _____.
quiz.solution: Prophet Musa (AS) is mentioned 136 times in the Qur'an across many Surahs.

quiz.q: A person who memorizes the entire Qur'an is called a _____.
quiz.solution: Hafiz (Guardian) is the title for someone who has committed the 6,236 verses of the Qur'an to memory.

quiz.q: The primary objective of 'Sawm' (fasting) as stated in the Qur'an is to achieve _____.
quiz.solution: Surat al-Baqarah 183 states: '...so that you may become God-fearing/righteous (Taqwa)'.

quiz.q: Which Caliph was known for his extreme modesty and for compiling the standard version of the Qur'an used today?
quiz.solution: Uthman (RA) ordered the standardized 'Uthmanic Codex' to be sent to all major Islamic cities to ensure uniformity.

quiz.q: The primary objective of 'Sawm' (fasting) as stated in the Qur'an is _____.
quiz.solution: Qur'an 2:183 states that fasting is prescribed so that you may achieve Taqwa (God-consciousness).
